```{r}
data <- updated_analysis_three_domain
library(lavaan)
library(semPlot)
high_ability_data <- data[data$high_ability == 2, ]
```

```{r}
# Load necessary package
library(lavaan)

# Define the SEM model
model <- '
  # Define the latent variable
  Daydreaming =~ Positive_dd + dysphoric_dd + attention_control

  # Regressions (direct effects)
  obj_under ~ Daydreaming
  sub_under ~ Daydreaming

  # Variances and covariances
  Positive_dd ~~ dysphoric_dd
  Positive_dd ~~ attention_control
  dysphoric_dd ~~ attention_control
'

# Fit the SEM model
fit <- sem(model, data = data, std.lv = TRUE)

# Summarize the results
summary(fit, fit.measures = TRUE, standardized = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(lavaan)

# Define the SEM model with three latent variables
model <- '
  # Latent variables
  PositiveDaydreaming =~ Positive_dd
  GuiltDaydreaming =~ dysphoric_dd
  AttentionControl =~ attention_control
  
  # Structural paths
  PositiveDaydreaming ~ high_ability
  GuiltDaydreaming ~ high_ability
  AttentionControl ~ high_ability
  
  obj_under ~ PositiveDaydreaming + GuiltDaydreaming + AttentionControl
  sub_under ~ PositiveDaydreaming + GuiltDaydreaming + AttentionControl
'

# Fit the model
fit <- sem(model, data = data, std.lv = TRUE)

# Summarize results
summary(fit, fit.measures = TRUE, standardized = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# Constrained model specification
model_constrained <- '
    # Direct effects on mediator (subjective underachievement)
    sub_under ~ a1*Positive_dd + a2*attention_control
    
    # Direct and mediated effects on outcome
    obj_under ~ c1*Positive_dd + c2*dysphoric_dd + c3*attention_control + b*sub_under
    
    # Significant covariances only
    Positive_dd ~~ attention_control
    dysphoric_dd ~~ attention_control
'

# Fit the constrained model
fit_constrained <- sem(model_constrained, 
                      data = high_ability_data,
                      ordered = c("obj_under", "sub_under"))

summary(fit_constrained, standardized = TRUE, fit.measures = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# Scale the continuous daydreaming variables
high_ability_data$Positive_dd_c <- scale(high_ability_data$Positive_dd)
high_ability_data$dysphoric_dd_c <- scale(high_ability_data$dysphoric_dd)
high_ability_data$attention_control_c <- scale(high_ability_data$attention_control)

# Create interaction terms with binary subjective underachievement
high_ability_data$dys_sub_inter <- high_ability_data$dysphoric_dd_c * (high_ability_data$sub_under - 1)
high_ability_data$att_sub_inter <- high_ability_data$attention_control_c * (high_ability_data$sub_under - 1)
high_ability_data$pos_sub_inter <- high_ability_data$Positive_dd_c * (high_ability_data$sub_under - 1)
```


```{r}
# Recode the binary variables (1,2 to 0,1)
high_ability_data$obj_under_rec <- high_ability_data$obj_under - 1
high_ability_data$sub_under_rec <- high_ability_data$sub_under - 1

# Standardize continuous predictors
high_ability_data$Positive_dd_c <- scale(high_ability_data$Positive_dd)
high_ability_data$dysphoric_dd_c <- scale(high_ability_data$dysphoric_dd)
high_ability_data$attention_control_c <- scale(high_ability_data$attention_control)

# Create interaction terms with recoded subjective underachievement
high_ability_data$dys_sub_inter <- high_ability_data$dysphoric_dd_c * high_ability_data$sub_under_rec
high_ability_data$att_sub_inter <- high_ability_data$attention_control_c * high_ability_data$sub_under_rec
high_ability_data$pos_sub_inter <- high_ability_data$Positive_dd_c * high_ability_data$sub_under_rec

# Fit logistic regression model with interactions using recoded variables
model <- glm(obj_under_rec ~ dysphoric_dd_c + attention_control_c + Positive_dd_c + 
             sub_under_rec + dys_sub_inter + att_sub_inter + pos_sub_inter,
             family = binomial(link = "logit"),
             data = high_ability_data)

# Examine results
summary(model)
```
```{r}
# Specify the mediation model
model_mediation <- '
    # Direct paths to mediator (subjective underachievement)
    sub_under ~ a1*Positive_dd + a2*dysphoric_dd + a3*attention_control

    # Direct paths to outcome (objective underachievement)
    obj_under ~ b*sub_under + c1*Positive_dd + c2*dysphoric_dd + c3*attention_control

    # Define indirect effects
    pos_indirect := a1*b
    dys_indirect := a2*b
    att_indirect := a3*b

    # Define total effects
    pos_total := c1 + (a1*b)
    dys_total := c2 + (a2*b)
    att_total := c3 + (a3*b)
'

# Fit the model with appropriate estimator for categorical variables
fit_mediation <- sem(model_mediation, 
                    data = high_ability_data,
                    ordered = c("obj_under", "sub_under"),
                    estimator = "DWLS")

# Request standardized solution and indirect effects
summary(fit_mediation, standardized = TRUE, fit.measures = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

# Create data for plotting
# Get range of dysphoric daydreaming scores
dd_range <- range(high_ability_data$dysphoric_dd_c)

# Create prediction data frame
pred_data <- expand.grid(
    dysphoric_dd_c = seq(dd_range[1], dd_range[2], length.out = 100),
    sub_under_rec = c(0, 1)
)

# Add other predictors at their means (0 since they're standardized)
pred_data$attention_control_c <- 0
pred_data$Positive_dd_c <- 0

# Calculate interaction terms
pred_data$dys_sub_inter <- pred_data$dysphoric_dd_c * pred_data$sub_under_rec
pred_data$att_sub_inter <- pred_data$attention_control_c * pred_data$sub_under_rec
pred_data$pos_sub_inter <- pred_data$Positive_dd_c * pred_data$sub_under_rec

# Calculate predicted probabilities
pred_data$predicted <- predict(model, newdata = pred_data, type = "response")

# Create the plot
ggplot(pred_data, aes(x = dysphoric_dd_c, y = predicted, color = factor(sub_under_rec))) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#2C3E50", "#E74C3C"),
                    labels = c("No Subjective Underachievement", 
                             "Subjective Underachievement"),
                    name = "Subjective\nUnderachievement Status") +
  labs(x = "Dysphoric Daydreaming (Standardized)",
       y = "Probability of Objective Underachievement",
       title = "Moderation Effect of Subjective Underachievement") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```

```{r}
# First, specify the model for multiple group analysis
model_multigroup <- '
    # Direct effects on mediator (subjective underachievement)
    sub_under ~ a1*Positive_dd + a2*dysphoric_dd + a3*attention_control

    # Direct and mediated effects on outcome (objective underachievement)
    obj_under ~ b*sub_under + c1*Positive_dd + c2*dysphoric_dd + c3*attention_control

    # Allow types of daydreaming to correlate
    Positive_dd ~~ dysphoric_dd
    Positive_dd ~~ attention_control
    dysphoric_dd ~~ attention_control

    # Define indirect effects
    pos_indirect := a1*b
    dys_indirect := a2*b
    att_indirect := a3*b
'
```

```{r}
model_multigroup <- '
    # Group 1 [Hong Kong]
    sub_under ~ a1_hk*Positive_dd + a2_hk*dysphoric_dd + a3_hk*attention_control
    obj_under ~ b_hk*sub_under + c1_hk*Positive_dd + c2_hk*dysphoric_dd + c3_hk*attention_control

    # Group 2 [USA]
    sub_under ~ a1_usa*Positive_dd + a2_usa*dysphoric_dd + a3_usa*attention_control
    obj_under ~ b_usa*sub_under + c1_usa*Positive_dd + c2_usa*dysphoric_dd + c3_usa*attention_control

    # Allow types of daydreaming to correlate in both groups
    Positive_dd ~~ dysphoric_dd
    Positive_dd ~~ attention_control
    dysphoric_dd ~~ attention_control
'
```


```{r}
# Fit the multiple group model
fit_multigroup <- sem(model_multigroup, 
                     data = high_ability_data,
                     group = "region",
                     group.equal = c("intercepts", "regressions"),
                     ordered = c("obj_under", "sub_under"),
                     parameterization = "theta",
                     estimator = "DWLS")

# Test for measurement invariance
fit_configural <- sem(model_multigroup, 
                     data = high_ability_data,
                     group = "region",
                     ordered = c("obj_under", "sub_under"),
                     parameterization = "theta",
                     estimator = "DWLS")

# Compare models to test for regional differences
anova(fit_multigroup, fit_configural)

# Get detailed results for each group
summary(fit_multigroup, standardized = TRUE, fit.measures = TRUE)
```

```{r}
model_multigroup <- '
    # Group-specific paths for Hong Kong
    group: "3" 
        sub_under ~ a1.hk*Positive_dd + a2.hk*dysphoric_dd + a3.hk*attention_control
        obj_under ~ b.hk*sub_under + c1.hk*Positive_dd + c2.hk*dysphoric_dd + c3.hk*attention_control
        
        # Correlations for Hong Kong
        Positive_dd ~~ dysphoric_dd + attention_control
        dysphoric_dd ~~ attention_control

    # Group-specific paths for USA
    group: "5"
        sub_under ~ a1.us*Positive_dd + a2.us*dysphoric_dd + a3.us*attention_control
        obj_under ~ b.us*sub_under + c1.us*Positive_dd + c2.us*dysphoric_dd + c3.us*attention_control
        
        # Correlations for USA
        Positive_dd ~~ dysphoric_dd + attention_control
        dysphoric_dd ~~ attention_control
'

# Fit the model with appropriate specifications
fit_multigroup <- sem(model_multigroup, 
                     data = high_ability_data,
                     group = "region",
                     ordered = c("obj_under", "sub_under"),
                     parameterization = "theta",
                     estimator = "DWLS")
# Get summaries for both models
summary(fit_multigroup, standardized = TRUE, fit.measures = TRUE)

```


```{r}
model_first_order <- '
    # Direct effects on mediator (subjective underachievement)
    sub_under ~ a1_3*Positive_dd + a2_3*dysphoric_dd + a3_3*attention_control
    sub_under ~ a1_5*Positive_dd + a2_5*dysphoric_dd + a3_5*attention_control

    # Direct and mediated effects on outcome (objective underachievement)
    obj_under ~ b_3*sub_under + c1_3*Positive_dd + c2_3*dysphoric_dd + c3_3*attention_control
    obj_under ~ b_5*sub_under + c1_5*Positive_dd + c2_5*dysphoric_dd + c3_5*attention_control

    # Allow types of daydreaming to correlate (same across groups)
    Positive_dd ~~ dysphoric_dd
    Positive_dd ~~ attention_control
    dysphoric_dd ~~ attention_control

    # Define indirect effects (group-specific)
    pos_indirect_3 := a1_3*b_3
    dys_indirect_3 := a2_3*b_3
    att_indirect_3 := a3_3*b_3

    pos_indirect_5 := a1_5*b_5
    dys_indirect_5 := a2_5*b_5
    att_indirect_5 := a3_5*b_5

    # Define total effects (group-specific)
    pos_total_3 := c1_3 + (a1_3*b_3)
    dys_total_3 := c2_3 + (a2_3*b_3)
    att_total_3 := c3_3 + (a3_3*b_3)

    pos_total_5 := c1_5 + (a1_5*b_5)
    dys_total_5 := c2_5 + (a2_5*b_5)
    att_total_5 := c3_5 + (a3_5*b_5)
'

# Fit the model
fit_first_order <- sem(model_first_order, 
                      data = high_ability_data,
                      group = "region", # Replace with your actual grouping variable
                      ordered = c("obj_under", "sub_under"),
                      parameterization = "theta",
                      estimator = "DWLS")

summary(fit_first_order, standardized = TRUE, fit.measures = TRUE)
```
